query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, cp.id as profile_id, cp.created_at
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.name LIKE '%Amanda%' OR u.email LIKE '%amanda%' OR u.email LIKE '%lord%'
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC;
